scope: Small-input full invocation counts, including initialization/checks; constant globalinitializers excluded. Type names not enough; physical shape retained. Scalar-box andprivate-capture collisions require source-role mapping; do not call all one-field numeric structures boxes.

rows.counter_mode: Counter-only full invocation under concurrent agent builds; emitted elapsed values are excluded as evidence.
rows.scope_caveat: Counts mark reached sites before operand evaluation, including possible failed/aborted operands. They are not completed operations or physical allocations. Scalar boxes do not establish concrete container/capture storage. Instrumentation changes optimization; timings are excluded.
